lesson_text: A claude/* PR opened after its first push gets two review runs on one head (the push-triggered branch review, then the pull_request review); whichever finishes first sees the other's job in progress, so a clean review hands off with 0 findings instead of auto-merging. Read the run log's `Claude-fixer clean review has no fresh ready same-head check-run snapshot` warning before judging such a round, and close it with the next real push (a due base sync or the log update), never a verdict or an empty commit.
